Good morning. It's **Swin** and **Andrew** here. In the second Trump era, we
realize how difficult it can be - even for avid, astute news consumers - to
keep track of all the madness. For instance, the president [invaded
Venezuela](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-venezuela-mexico-invasion-attack-cartels)
this year, then immediately pivoted to threatening an [invasion of
Greenland](https://zeteo.com/p/scoop-trump-still-wants-greenland), only to
move on to further [invading parts of his own
country](https://zeteo.com/p/donald-trump-ice-occupation-minnesota), right
before starting a [new, illegal bloodbath in the Middle
East](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/1JDfamDVHjY).

**Donald Trump** isn't even done with his failing war on Iran yet - but he
could soon add another country to the list.

In today's '**First Draft** ,' the president has his team planning another act
of war elsewhere, two accused creeps in Congress are calling it quits, and the
Republican Party is a big tent when it comes to whether its politicians
believe the US president should proclaim himself Jesus and scream at the pope.

History's cattiest warmonger, Donald Trump, continues to publicly dangle a US
invasion of Cuba, the island nation that his administration has been
strangling to death with a brutal, months-long [energy
blockade](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/nation/u-s-lawmakers-visiting-cuba-
denounce-effects-of-economic-bombing-under-energy-blockade).

**" We may stop by Cuba after we're finished with this,"** Trump said Monday -
meaning once his disastrous war in Iran actually ends.

It was an insane moment, as Trump stood next to a woman wearing a **" DoorDash
grandma"** shirt for a corporate White House photo-op. (At the same event,
Trump [claimed](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-insulted-christians-9-times) he had
only _mistakenly_ committed blasphemy when he posted an image depicting
himself as Jesus, because he thought it was **" me as a doctor."**)

This isn't the first time the president has threatened to invade Cuba. It's
not even the first time he's made this threat _during_ the US-Israeli war in
Iran, which is throttling the global economy. **" Cuba is going to be next,"**
Trump [said](https://www.tiktok.com/@cnn/video/7622996503706995981) two weeks
ago.

It would be one thing if President Trump were only mouthing off for the
cameras. He's not.

In recent days, according to two sources familiar with the situation and
another person briefed on it, officials at the Pentagon and elsewhere in the
US government were quietly given a new directive that came straight from the
Trump White House. The message: ramp up your preparations for possible
military operations against Cuba.
